_note: ARAM builds for full champion roster. Patch 26.9 / Season 16. Updated 2026-05-02 (s33) — removed arena-only Hexoptics C44 contamination from 4 champs.
_format: build_note is the coaching-relevant line injected into ARAM coach system prompt.

Aatrox.build_note: Deathbringer Stance (passive): every ~25s auto deals % max HP bonus damage — weave autos between abilities. The Darkin Blade (Q) — 3 swings: last swing is AOE knockup. Sweet spot of each Q is the edges, not the center. World Ender (R) heals for 70% of damage dealt — engage R, burst as much as possible, sustain back to full. Never use R to finish — use it to survive.
Aatrox.vs_tanks: Thornmail — sustained fights where Deathbringer Stance proc is most valuable
Aatrox.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs poke burst

Ahri.build_note: E (Charm) is the combo opener — Charmed enemies take 20% bonus damage from all sources. Full combo: E-charm → W orbs through target → Q returning charm → R dash1-burst → R dash2-escape. Luden's + charm bonus = massive burst window. R (Spirit Rush) 3-dash reset on kill — never use R to engage, use it to execute THEN escape.
Ahri.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all sources are magic damage
Ahri.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke mages (Lux, Xerath)

Akali.build_note: W (Twilight Shroud) smoke cloud gives invisibility — use to dodge enemy abilities or gain time. Five Point Strike (Q): outer ring applies slow, inner ring is full damage. E (Shuriken Flip) first hit retreats, second dash engages — fire first cast away then re-engage with second. R (Perfect Execution) two-part dash: R1 knocks back, R2 executes. Never R until target is vulnerable.
Akali.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Lich Bane vs burst

Akshan.build_note: Heroic Swing (E) hooks terrain for aerial mobility — use as escape OR to flank. W (Going Rogue) marks villains; kill the villain to revive all allies that villain killed. Phantom Dancer ghost supplements E for gap-closing. Comeuppance (R) long channel that one-shots; use after E to dodge counterattack.
Akshan.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Akshan.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs heavy burst

Alistar.build_note: W-Q combo (headbutt then pulverize): W dashes + knocks back, immediately Q to knock up. This must be done in order: W → Q. Combo: dash behind enemy carry → W to knock them toward team → Q to knock up at feet of your team. R Unbreakable Will negates 75% of damage — activate when being dove to become nearly unkillable for 7 seconds.
Alistar.vs_tanks: Thornmail — autos apply grievous during W headbutt chain
Alistar.vs_burst: Unbreakable Will (R) reduces damage by 75% — activate when focused

Ambessa.build_note: Cunning (passive) marks enemies — next attack deals bonus damage. Grand Entrance (W) AOE dash with follow-up. Restock (Q) refreshes W — dash then Q refresh for second dash. Vicious Assault (E) forward rush. Grand Entrance (R) full screen dash to a target followed by explosions. High mobility fighter — chain dashes to reach backline.
Ambessa.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical damage full armor pen
Ambessa.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Ambessa.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Death's Dance vs burst

Amumu.build_note: Q (Bandage Toss) hooks one target — use to initiate or hook fleeing enemies. R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) stuns everyone in range — most powerful ARAM ult when enemy groups. Build AP or full tank: full tank = tankier and more consistent. Timing: wait for all 5 enemies to group, then Q one → W tantrum → R stun everyone.
Amumu.vs_tanks: Thornmail on enemy tanks applying grievous during Curse of the Sad Mummy
Amumu.vs_healing: Thornmail in core — grievous on autos during R
Amumu.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Annie.build_note: Stun passive charges on every ability cast — track stacks. At 4 stacks, next ability stuns. Combo: pre-charge to 4 stacks → W Incinerate AOE stun → R Tibbers on stun location → Q Disintegrate (free cast, refunds mana if kills). Tibbers aggros everything nearby — point him at carries. Molten Shield (E) reflect damage onto attackers.
Annie.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Tibbers AOE magic damage through MR
Annie.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Aphelios.build_note: Season 16: Yun Tal gives 0% crit (pure AS). Fix build: RFC second for 25% crit, Collector third for 50% crit before IE. Turret (Infernum crescendum) setup at chokepoints wins ARAM. Learn weapon rotations — Gravitum root into Infernum/Calibrum for combo kills.
Aphelios.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — Calibrum (sniper) shots apply LDR from safety
Aphelios.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Aphelios.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 4th replaces The Collector vs heavy burst dive
Aphelios.kit_notes: Weapons cycle: Calibrum (long range), Severum (heals), Gravitum (slow/root), Infernum (AoE), Crescendum (turret). Ult varies by off-hand: Calibrum = mark all enemies, Infernum = AOE cone (best in ARAM), Gravitum = root all. Gravitum R into Infernum ult = root then AOE sweep.
Aphelios.aram_specific: Infernum (blue flame) ult in grouped ARAM = AOE sweep hitting everyone. Pre-stack Gravitum (grey chains) before fights for root. Place Crescendum turret at chokepoints during laning. Calibrum Q at max range for free poke between weapons.

Ashe.build_note: RFC first — empowered Frost Shot at max range procs Ranger's Focus (Q) for AOE slow. IE second (RFC 25% crit; IE 25% = 50% total before adding IE — need one more crit item first). Fix: RFC → Collector (50% total) → IE (75%, fully active). Ult any grouped fight from max range at fight start — it's free damage and disruption.
Ashe.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards mandatory — perma-slow keeps tanks in range for LDR procs
Ashe.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Ashe.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster — ISB + perma-slow = bait dive then shield
Ashe.kit_notes: Q (Ranger's Focus) at max stacks: fires cone of arrows that AOE slow. Every auto is a slow. W (Volley) pokes and slows the entire ARAM corridor. Crystal Arrow (R) travels the full ARAM map — throw it at fight start from fountain for guaranteed hit. Hawkshot vision before fights.
Ashe.aram_specific: R from fountain range hits any grouped ARAM fight. Never stand in melee range — RFC + max range Frost Shot means you can slow everything without being in danger. Q stack up before fights using minions, then dump on enemy frontline for AOE slow.

Aurelion Sol.build_note: Every ability kill/assist builds Stardust permanently — more stardust = bigger abilities. Q (Breath of Light) sustained beam: hold for maximum stardust stacks. W (Astral Flight) fly over terrain — use to close distance. E (Singularity) black hole grows and pulls. R (Falling Star/The Skies Descend) at 75 stardust: meteor impact + aftershock. Prioritize collecting stardust stacks every fight.
Aurelion Sol.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Stardust stacks increase all ability sizes
Aurelion Sol.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs burst

Aurora.build_note: Two Worlds (R) creates a realm that empowers Aurora's abilities — activate before full combo. Q (Twofold Hex) marks then detonates on second cast. W (Across the Void) hop over terrain — use for repositioning escape. E (Between Worlds) teleports to other side of gap. Lich Bane procs on Q detonation for bonus damage on landing.
Aurora.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Azir.build_note: Soldiers (W) attack anything Azir autos. Q (Conquering Sands) sends soldiers forward — move soldier to group, then Q to shove multiple enemies. E (Arise) summons soldier at obelisk. R (Emperor's Divide) wall of soldiers pushes enemies and blocks movement. In ARAM: place soldiers at max range and spam Q to harass the entire line. R blocks entire enemy advance at chokepoints.
Azir.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; soldiers apply on-hit
Azir.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Bard.build_note: Cosmic Binding (Q) stuns when it hits two targets or passes through and hits terrain. Caretaker's Shrine (W) health packs that fill over time — place near health packs for double-pack. Magical Journey (E) tunnel for allies — place tunnels through walls to create escape routes. Tempered Fate (R) freezes EVERYTHING in an area including allies and enemies — use to freeze enemy team or save dying allies. Collect Chimes for haste.
Bard.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari in core

Bel'Veth.build_note: Lavender Sea (passive) RAMPANT GROWTH: attack speed from kills, permanent AS stacks. Void Surge (Q) 4 directional dashes — always Q toward target for attack speed proc. Above and Below (W) tail slam knockup. Royal Maelstrom (E) damage reduction + heavy attacks during channel. Endless Banquet (R) Void form: enhanced stats and true form. On-hit build amplifies every Lavender Sea auto.
Bel'Veth.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR — Lavender Sea on-hit stacks multiply with Kraken
Bel'Veth.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Bel'Veth.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Mortal Reminder vs burst

Blitzcrank.build_note: Q (Rocket Grab) is your entire game — hit it, win the fight. Hook carries, not tanks. E (Power Fist) uppercutt after hook for airborne extension. R (Static Field) suppresses nearby enemies — use in group fights for silence + damage. Never hook tanks. Prioritize isolated carries stepping forward for health packs.
Blitzcrank.vs_tanks: Thornmail — grievous on autos after hook
Blitzcrank.vs_burst: Force of Nature replaces Frozen Heart vs heavy AP

Brand.build_note: Blaze stacks (3 = detonation): W stun confirms triple stack. Combo: W-stun → Q-stun → E-bouncing pillar → R-bouncing ult. R (Pyroclasm) bounces between grouped enemies up to 5 times. In ARAM: W a group, walk through pillar (E), then ult for 5-bounce chain. Rylai's slows everything hit by Blaze explosions.
Brand.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Blaze passives deal % max HP magic damage
Brand.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Morellonomicon vs burst mages

Braum.build_note: Stand Behind Me (W) leap to ally — stay attached to your ADC. Unbreakable (E) blocks projectiles including Jinx rockets, Lux ult, Ashe ult — face the damage. R (Glacial Fissure) knockup along a line — throw diagonally across ARAM corridor. Concussive Blows: mark with Q, let allies complete 4-stack stun.
Braum.vs_tanks: Thornmail applies grievous on autos — Concussive Blows needs 4 stacks from allies
Braum.vs_burst: Aegis of the Legion (component) into Locket gives team-wide shield

Briar.build_note: No Mercy (passive) bleeds everything in range — she heals from all bleed damage. Crimson Curse (Q) bleed attack. Snack Attack (W) eats an enemy or ally. Head Rush (E) leap: breaks restraint, leaps to target. Bloody Business (R) frenzy: targets nearest enemy champion ignoring everything. ARAM note: R in crowd = she attacks everyone, heals massively from bleed. Don't R in a losing fight.
Briar.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical damage; headrush frenzy into armor pen
Briar.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Briar.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Caitlyn.build_note: Hexoptics C44 first (55 AD + 25% crit) — triggers headshot every 6 autos or on trap/net. RFC second (25% crit) for empowered long-range headshot at max range. IE third (50% crit from Hexoptics + RFC before IE = IE fully active at 75%). Trap all health pack paths — every trap is a free headshot proc.
Caitlyn.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th — swap to Mortal Reminder vs healing, never both
Caitlyn.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Caitlyn.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs heavy burst — still reaches IE threshold
Caitlyn.kit_notes: Hexoptics C44 headshot triggers after: 6 autos, stepping on trap, or getting hit by net (E). RFC headshot at max range crits for massive damage. Traps at chokepoints force enemies off health packs. E-net to interrupt dashes/escapes. Never use E offensively — it's your escape and net combo.
Caitlyn.aram_specific: Trap all 4 health pack approach paths at game start. RFC extends Q and headshot range to 850+ — stay at absolute max range. Enemies stepping on traps give free headshots which crit with RFC active. Never dash forward with E — it's your only escape vs dive.

Camille.build_note: Adaptive Defenses (passive) shields vs dominant damage type of the last champion hit. Precision Protocol (Q) two hits: second hit crits for huge damage and slows. Tactical Sweep (W) outer edge slows AND heals Camille. Hookshot (E) two-part: hook terrain then kick off for 1s stun on landing. The Hextech Ultimatum (R) traps target in a zone — use on carry, then burst them in the cage.
Camille.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — Hookshot into armor pen stack
Camille.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Camille.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Cassiopeia.build_note: Twin Fang (E) resets CD when hitting poisoned target — infinite spam vs poisoned enemy. Apply poison with Q (Noxious Blast) or W (Miasma). Rylai's slow applies on every E cast = permanent slow vs poisoned target. R (Petrifying Gaze) stuns enemies facing you, slows others — turn away from Cassiopeia to not get stunned.
Cassiopeia.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Noxious Blast (Q) can apply slow for Twin Fang spam
Cassiopeia.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Morellonomicon vs burst

Cho'Gath.build_note: Feast (R) executes and gives permanent HP stacks — eat minions/monsters for free HP; only use on champions when they're low enough to confirm kill. Rupture (Q) delayed AOE knock-up at cursor: aim slightly ahead of moving targets. Feral Scream (W) cone silence — point at carries during fights. Vorpal Spikes (E passive) AOE cone on auto attacks. More HP from Feast = bigger Gargoyle shield and more AOE Vorpal damage.
Cho'Gath.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Feast (R) true damage ignores all resistances
Cho'Gath.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Corki.build_note: 50% AD / 50% Magic mixed damage — partially ignores both resistances. Package (Special Delivery) mega-bomb does massive magic damage and leaves fire. Phosphorus Bombs (Q) reveal brush. Valkyrie (W) napalm trail — fly over enemy group for damage zone. Gatling Gun (E) shreds both armor and MR. TF Spellblade procs on every spell for bonus magic damage.
Corki.vs_tanks: LDR — TF(0%)+Collector(25%)+RFC(25%)+IE(25%)=75% crit; Q is magic damage
Corki.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Corki.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs burst

Darius.build_note: Decimate (Q) outer ring heals Darius — position so only the outer blade hits enemy, not the handle. Hemorrhage (passive) 5 stacks = Noxian Might (free AD) for 5s. Apprehend (E) pulls enemies — use to yank backline carries from behind. R (Noxian Guillotine) resets on kill — chain R kills through grouped ARAM enemies.
Darius.vs_tanks: Thornmail — autos during Hemorrhage bleed apply grievous
Darius.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage in core — activates at low HP

Diana.build_note: Crescent Strike (Q) arc — mark target for Moonsilver Blade empowered auto. Pale Cascade (W) 3 orbs burst when hit during channel + shield. Lunar Rush (E) dash resets when you hit Q-marked target. Moonfall (R) when near enemy champions: pull ALL nearby enemies to Diana then AOE burst. In ARAM: Q the group → E dash in → W → R pull all 5 → Zhonya's to survive.
Diana.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Moonfall (R) can pull entire ARAM group
Diana.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Dr. Mundo.build_note: Adrenaline Rush (passive) heals 0.8% max HP per second. All abilities cost HP. Maximum Dosage (R) gains 20% HP instantly AND heals %max HP over 10s — use R when at 30% HP for full sustain recovery. Infected Bonesaw (Q) slows and does % current HP magic damage. Blunt Force Trauma (E) empowered autos deal bonus HP damage. Face Breaker (W) pins enemies to terrain — use to prevent enemy escape. Build max HP: every % heal ability heals more.
Dr. Mundo.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Maximum Dosage (R) heals % of max HP — more HP = more R heal
Dr. Mundo.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Force of Nature vs burst

Draven.build_note: Catch BOTH axes on every throw — double catch means permanent Spinning Axes active. Never stand still while axes are in the air. Stand (E) blocks and sends back any projectile. R League of Draven stacks: every kill/death multiplies damage. Use R to finish grouped low-HP enemies.
Draven.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards — Spinning Axe crits proc LDR
Draven.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing
Draven.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow — delays IE but safer

Ekko.build_note: W (Parallel Convergence) circle: place it on where enemy group WILL BE, it activates 3s later for a stun. Z-Drive Resonance (passive): 3 ability hits stun the target briefly. R (Chronobreak) rewinds to ghost position from 3s ago AND deals damage in AOE around it — use when low HP to escape AND damage. TF Spellblade procs on Q for massive burst.
Ekko.vs_tanks: Void Staff — W circle applies slow and can stun on second activation
Ekko.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke burst

Elise.build_note: Human form: E cocoon stuns → Q burst → W volatile spiderling. Spider form: Q pounce → E rappel dodge → auto autos with spiderlings. Cocoon → Q → swap to spider → Q pounce → rappel to dodge counterattack. Rappel (Spider E) makes Elise untargetable briefly — use to dodge enemy ultimates mid-combo.
Elise.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; cocoon into spider dive combo
Elise.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Evelynn.build_note: Last Caress (R) execute: double damage below 35% HP AND dashes away after. Allure (W) charm: stacks reduce MR when detonated. Hate Spike (Q) fires 4 times — each hit deals more damage than the last. Ravage (E) two swipes. ARAM: no invisibility without deep stealth so play aggressively: W charm → Q spam → E → R execute and escape.
Evelynn.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Ezreal.build_note: Trinity Force first — Spellblade procs every Q for massive empowered auto. Muramana stacks fast with Q spam, dramatically increases sustained DPS mid-game. Never build pure crit on Ezreal — his Q autos proc on-hit effects. Ult across the map hits every grouped ARAM fight for free poke damage.
Ezreal.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards + Serylda's Grudge — double armor pen stack
Ezreal.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Ezreal.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster — shields during E blink escape
Ezreal.kit_notes: Q (Mystic Shot) applies Sheen/Spellblade AND applies on-hit effects (Muramana bonus). Stack Manamune to Muramana by spamming Q. Arcane Shift (E) is both gap-close and escape — time it carefully. W (Essence Flux) marks enemies for increased Q damage. R (Trueshot Barrage) is free damage on grouped ARAM fights — throw it early every fight.
Ezreal.aram_specific: Poke freely with Q — it has 1150 range and minimal mana cost after Muramana stacks. Ult at grouped enemies through walls and across map at start of every fight. Never be in melee range. Use E backward when engaged, not forward.

Fiddlesticks.build_note: Crowstorm (R) blink to area then AOE channeling drain for 5s — enter from out-of-vision for surprise maximum duration. ARAM: disguise as scarecrow (stand still for 2.5s for maximum fear), then R into grouping enemies. Bountiful Harvest (W) AOE multi-target drain heals Fiddlesticks. Terrify (Q) on enemy without Dread = fear; on enemy already fearing = extra damage. Reap (E) silence cone. Zhonya's mid-channel to survive burst.
Fiddlesticks.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Crowstorm deals massive AOE
Fiddlesticks.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Fiora.build_note: Grand Challenge (R) reveals all 4 Vitals on one target — burst all 4 for massive heal. Vitals (passive) deal % max HP true damage regardless of armor — always be hitting the glowing Vital. Lunge (Q) two-part dash to target; resets on Vital hit. Riposte (W) parry + counter — use W exactly when enemy ability hits to reflect back. Bladework (E) empowered autos. ARAM: TF Spellblade + Vital true damage = shred any tank.
Fiora.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — Vitals (passive) % max HP true damage ignores armor entirely
Fiora.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Fiora.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Fizz.build_note: Urchin Strike (Q) dash through target, applies on-hit. Seastone Trident (W) applies grievous wounds — active during combo. Playful/Trickster (E) first part untargetable, second small area stun OR extended dodge. Chum the Waters (R) shark pulls enemies to it. Full combo: R at group → W active → Q through main target → E land near target → auto. Time E to dodge burst while in combo.
Fizz.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Galio.build_note: Hero's Entrance (R) global teleport to any ally — in ARAM, R to ally engaging, then AOE knock-up on arrival. Winds of War (Q) large AOE tornado between two gusts. Shield of Durand (W) charge then taunt entire nearby enemy team — taunt is huge in ARAM when enemies are grouped. Justice Punch (E) dash with knock-back. Time W charge carefully — interrupt W cast to avoid being interrupted mid-taunt.
Galio.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Colossal Smash (passive) deals magic damage bonus
Galio.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Gangplank.build_note: Trinity Force first for Spellblade on Q crits. Collector (25%) + RFC (25%) + IE (25%) = 75% total crit — IE passive fully active. Q with RFC fires empowered long-range shot. Barrel chains (E): connect 3 for massive AOE slow + fire. R (Cannon Barrage) globally every fight.
Gangplank.vs_tanks: LDR — Parrrley (Q) crits and applies LDR through armor
Gangplank.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both

Garen.build_note: Perseverance (passive) heals at full rate when out of combat — collect health packs and regen between fights. Decisive Strike (Q) silences + bonus damage on next auto — use Q before auto for silence proc. Judgment (E) spin — spin into grouped enemies for AOE damage. Demacian Justice (R) deals damage based on how many stacks of Villain the target has — use on fed enemies for bonus damage.
Garen.vs_tanks: Thornmail — spin applies grievous to tanks during E

Gnar.build_note: Mini Gnar: ranged poke, collect Rage. At max Rage: transform to Mega Gnar for teamfight. Mega Gnar: GNAR! (R) throws enemies against a wall — in ARAM, throw the entire group against the side wall. W (Wallop) giant AOE slam. Build full tank to maximize teamfight Mega Gnar duration. Never transform unless 5 enemies are grouped.
Gnar.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Mega Gnar W and R have huge AoE; armor stacking amplifies tankyness

Gragas.build_note: Barrel Roll (Q) exploding barrel — can be detonated early with recast. Body Slam (E) charge: stuns on hit. Explosive Cask (R) keg blast THROWS enemies — use to knock carries away from their team or throw tanks into YOUR team. Happy Hour (passive) heals on ability cast. Drunken Rage (W) channel briefly then empowered auto. R direction matters: aim BEHIND carries to throw them deeper into your team.
Gragas.vs_tanks: Void Staff — AP tank hybrid; Body Slam damage scales with AP
Gragas.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Graves.build_note: Buckshot (Q) spreads at close range for full damage — step close before Q for all pellets to hit. Smoke Screen (W) blocks enemy vision and slows inside — drop it on grouped enemies for maximum disorientation. Quickdraw (E) gives armor stacks per use — dash before taking burst for shield. R (Collateral Damage) knockback: use to push frontline away and finish backline. RELOAD between autos — plan movements around reload time.
Graves.vs_tanks: LDR — True Grit passive reduces damage from frontline, LDR shreds them
Graves.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing
Graves.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs burst

Gwen.build_note: Hallowed Mist (W) magic mist: in mist, Gwen takes 25% less damage and enemies outside CANNOT target her. Place W, step in, and swing freely. Snip Snip! (Q) scissors can only be dodged by stepping out of the cone — Hallowed Mist blocks escape. Thousand Cuts (passive) on-hit magic percent HP damage. Riftmaker sustains extended fights. Keep W active during every teamfight.
Gwen.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Needlework and Snip synergize with AP
Gwen.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Hecarim.build_note: Rampage (Q) reduces cooldown per hit — chain Q stacks for continuous damage cycle. Spirit of Dread (W) heals Hecarim for % of damage allies deal during its duration — use during grouped teamfights for massive heal. Devastating Charge (E) charge up then ram: more MS = more damage. Onslaught of Shadows (R) ghost charge with fear AOE — charge through ARAM corridor for multi-fear.
Hecarim.vs_tanks: LDR — Rampage (Q) stacks and scales with bonus AD (TF provides this)
Hecarim.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both

Heimerdinger.build_note: Place turrets at max range forward — they fire 3x AS when you're nearby. Q turret upgrade (UPGRADE! + Q) fires single huge beam. W (Hextech Micro-Rockets) cluster burst. E (CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade) stun on direct hit, slow on edge. In ARAM: place 3 turrets at choke, stay behind them for free damage. UPGRADE! + Q fires enhanced ability: beam turret fires endlessly during R.
Heimerdinger.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; turrets ignore MR scaling with Void Staff
Heimerdinger.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs burst

Hwei.build_note: QE (Severing Bolt) marks and deals damage after delay — use on stationary/slowed targets. QW (Molten Fissure) AOE burn in ARAM corridor. WE (Grim Visage) fears enemies — use to interrupt grouped dives. EQ (Gaze of the Abyss) roots caught enemies. R (Spiraling Despair) — massive AOE that despairs all enemies within: use during enemy engage for max impact.
Hwei.vs_tanks: Void Staff + QQ (Devastating Fire) for % HP damage
Hwei.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs long-range poke

Illaoi.build_note: Test of Spirit (E) yanks enemy spirit out — damage spirit = damage the real champion. Prophet of an Elder God (passive) spawns tentacles near Illaoi. Tentacle Smash (Q) empowers nearby tentacle slam. Harsh Lesson (W) dashes to enemy while spawning tentacle. Leap of Faith (R) spawns a tentacle for EACH nearby enemy champion — group fight with R = 5 tentacles slamming everyone. R in grouped ARAM = win condition.
Illaoi.vs_tanks: Thornmail — tentacle slams heal Illaoi; more hits = more heal

Irelia.build_note: Bladesurge (Q) resets on kills including minions — stay near minion wave for reset chains. Ionian Fervor (passive) stacks on ability hits: 6 stacks = max DPS window. E (Flawless Duet) — two blades that stun between them: throw E1 behind enemy, E2 in front for guaranteed stun. R (Vanguard's Edge) — don't chase with it, use to set up E stuns.
Irelia.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's slow — Bladesurge to low-HP minions after killing a champion
Irelia.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing (never both)
Irelia.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Ivern.build_note: Daisy (R) summons a giant plant companion that fights for Ivern — send Daisy at the carry. Rootcaller (Q) roots an enemy; Ivern or Daisy can dash to rooted target. Brushmaker (W) creates brush for stealth and MS. Triggerseed (E) shield that explodes after 2s — put on diving ally for AoE slow explosion. In ARAM: E shield on aggressor to punish dives, Q root the carry, Daisy attacks them.
Ivern.vs_tanks: No anti-tank — Daisy (R) does the fighting
Ivern.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari in core

Janna.build_note: Eye of the Storm (E) shield on carry or turret before fights. Monsoon (R) MASSIVE knockback — use to knock the entire enemy team away from your team. Howling Gale (Q) tornado: charge time = more knock-up height — hold Q while team repositions. Zephyr (W) passive gives movement speed to dodge skillshots. R is both offensive (scatter enemy engage) and defensive (heal your team).
Janna.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Mikael's vs burst

Jarvan IV.build_note: Demacian Standard (E) flag + Dragon Strike (Q) under it = dash and knock-up at flag location. Combo: throw E flag → Q through target → knock-up → Cataclysm (R) for arena cage. R traps the carry in an enclosed arena — burst them before they escape. R creates terrain so anyone in the cage cannot leave (unless they have a dash). In ARAM: E+Q knock-up → R cage the carry → burst.
Jarvan IV.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — Demacian Standard + Cataclysm burst scaling
Jarvan IV.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both

Jax.build_note: Counter Strike (E) dodges all auto attacks for 2s then stuns in AOE — use vs any auto-attack carry. Stack AS stacks (Relentless Assault passive) then E to dodge burst then stun. Grandmaster's Might (R) active: AOE on every third auto for 8s — maintain auto weaving during R. Leaping Strike (Q) gap-close, applies on-hit. Empower (W) empowered auto after Q for double proc.
Jax.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — Grandmaster's Might (R) deals magic damage too
Jax.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Jax.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Jayce.build_note: Ranged: Q cannon blast long range; W energy field slows; E accelerated cannon far Q. Melee: Q hammer dash; W AOE lightning slam; E thunder clap AOE. Combo: E accelerate → ranged Q launch → swap to melee → melee Q dash to target → W lightning slam. Manage swap cooldown (6s) — don't swap mid-trade. In ARAM: ranged form for poke phase, melee for all-in.
Jayce.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical with magic mixed damage
Jayce.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Jayce.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Jhin.build_note: Hexoptics C44 first (55 AD + 25% crit) — Jhin gains AD from crit, so crit items scale his base damage. RFC second (25% crit, 50% total) for the empowered long-range 4th shot. IE third (IE passive active at 50%+ crit before adding IE's own). 4th shot crits with RFC for 30%+ HP on squishies. W root from fog of war wins trades.
Jhin.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th — armor pen amplifies his fixed-damage 4th shot
Jhin.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Jhin.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs heavy dive — delays IE one slot
Jhin.kit_notes: Jhin has 4 shots then a reload — plan your 4th shot as the crit/execute. W (Deadly Flourish) roots enemies who have been hit by minions or allies recently — look for rooted kills in ARAM constant damage. Lotus Trap (E) slows approaching enemies — place at health pack paths. Curtain Call (R) from safe angle after engage.
Jhin.aram_specific: The ARAM corridor means every 4th shot can hit grouped enemies. Use W roots to lock down grouped fights. Position behind your frontline — his reload is a vulnerability window. Lotus Traps slow enemies approaching your side. R from behind cover after your team engages.

Jinx.build_note: Yun Tal Wildarrows first for AS + AD — Season 16 Yun Tal gives 0% crit so build RFC second to reach 25% crit, then Collector (50% total) before IE (75% crit, IE passive fully active). Switch to rockets after first reset kill — rockets hit multiple targets and chain resets. Never stop shooting.
Jinx.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — or replace BT slot if already ahead
Jinx.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Jinx.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs heavy burst/dive — delays IE but safer
Jinx.kit_notes: Rockets in ARAM hit every grouped enemy every auto. Crit threshold for IE: RFC(25%) + Collector(25%) = 50% before IE → 75% total. Reset passive (Jinx Get Excited) activates on any kill/assist — use aggression resets freely. W flame chompers for zoning packs. E mine field at health pack approaches.
Jinx.aram_specific: ARAM is Jinx's best game mode. Grouped enemies + infinite ammo + reset passive = snowball engine. Use rockets the moment you get a reset. Super Mega Death Rocket at 70%+ HP enemies — don't use as execute, the damage scales with missing HP of the FIRST target hit.

Kai'Sa.build_note: Plasma stacks (5 = Void Explosion): apply with autos and W, detonate with ally CC. W evolves at 100 AP — Kraken + ISB pushes toward AP evolution. E (Supercharge) evolved at 100% AS = invisible dash. R: charge into ally CC on low-HP target. Never ult without ally followup CC.
Kai'Sa.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + LDR — W mark applies Plasma stacks, Kraken procs on empowered auto
Kai'Sa.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing
Kai'Sa.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector — evolves W at 100 AP

Kalista.build_note: Sentinel passive: ally standing still for 1.5s syncs with Kalista. Rend (E) pulls ALL spears from ALL targets simultaneously — use when 4+ spears stacked. Hurricane plants 3 spears per auto. Fate's Call (R) throws your support at enemies — coordinate with support for knock-up engage. Never stand still after casting anything.
Kalista.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + LDR — Rend (E) detonates on-hit stacks through all targets
Kalista.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing
Kalista.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 5th as shield vs burst

Karma.build_note: Mantra (R) empowers next ability: empowered Q deals AOE burst AND slows, empowered W heals + roots, empowered E shields allies around target. Use Mantra-Q for damage, Mantra-W to save ally, Mantra-E for teamfight shield + speed. Gathering Fire passive: ability hits on champions reduce Mantra CD. Always have Mantra ready for fights.
Karma.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Mantra-Q AOE magic burst
Karma.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Moonstone vs heavy burst

Karthus.build_note: Q (Lay Waste) deals double damage to isolated targets — position for 1v1 hits not group Q. Wall of Pain (W) reduces MR briefly — walk through W before Q/E for bonus damage. Defile (E) AOE always on: toggle only when mana permits sustained fight. R (Requiem) hits ALL enemies globally — throw it every grouped fight.
Karthus.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all damage is magic
Karthus.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Morellonomicon vs heavy burst

Kassadin.build_note: Null Sphere (Q) silences AND gives brief magic shield — use before enemy ability lands. Riftwalk (R) short blink with stacking mana cost. At 6 items: spam R every 2s for massive AOE. Nether Blade (W) bonus magic damage on auto. ARAM note: stacks fast due to constant fighting — reach R spam tempo quickly by fighting every wave.
Kassadin.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Null Sphere (Q) magic damage, scales with AP
Kassadin.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke damage

Katarina.build_note: Reset mechanic: every kill/assist reduces all CDs by 15s. Combo: W dagger drop → E blink to dagger → Shunpo Q → R Sinister Steel spin. R requires stay in place — only channel when you have a reset from prior kill OR have Zhonya's ready. Never R without escape plan. E blinks to daggers OR to enemies — pick up daggers first for damage bonus.
Katarina.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all sources magic damage
Katarina.vs_healing: No anti-heal — burst carry then reset
Katarina.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Lich Bane vs burst

Kayle.build_note: Guinsoo's Rageblade converts crit chance to double on-hit procs — synergizes with Nashor's. Level 11+ ranged flame swords: stand at max range and auto the entire team. W heal before diving. R makes one ally invincible — ult your carry during enemy R, not afterward.
Kayle.vs_tanks: Void Staff — ranged magic flame swords melt tanks
Kayle.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Riftmaker vs burst

Kayn.build_note: Darkin form (Rhaast — fighting tanks/bruisers): heals from abilities. Shadow Assassin (Blue — fighting squishies): bonus magic damage burst. Reaping Slash (Q) dash. Blade's Reach (W) AOE vertical. Shadow Step (E) wall-walk. Umbral Trespass (R) enter and burst from inside target. In ARAM: collect Darkin orbs vs frontline or Shadow Assassin orbs vs carries. Rhaast build for tanks. Blue needs full lethality build instead.
Kayn.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's for Darkin; Rhaast form only — Blue Kayn uses different build
Kayn.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs 2+ healing
Kayn.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow for Rhaast form vs burst

Kennen.build_note: Mark of the Storm stacks from abilities — 3 marks = stun. Thundering Shuriken (Q) long range mark. Electrical Surge (W) AOE proc + passive mark reset. Lightning Rush (E) dash with bonus armor/MR during channel. Slicing Maelstrom (R) AOE constant lightning storm — stand inside the enemy group during R for maximum hits and stuns. Nashor's + R = on-hit marks during storm.
Kennen.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Mark of the Storm (passive) stun on 3 hits
Kennen.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Kha'Zix.build_note: Unseen Threat (passive) when emerging from brush/stealth: bonus damage + slow on auto. Taste Their Fear (Q) deals bonus damage to isolated targets — burst carries isolated from allies. Void Spike (W) poke + heal at range. Leap (E) resets on kill. R Void Assault: 3 brief stealth uses reset Unseen Threat. ARAM: use brush edges to proc Unseen Threat before each combo.
Kha'Zix.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical damage full armor pen stack
Kha'Zix.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Kha'Zix.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Serpent's Fang vs burst

Kindred.build_note: Mark targets via Lamb's Respite passive (R passive): collecting marks increases all damage. Mark the enemy carry. Wolf's Frenzy (W) wolf attacks nearby enemies — place inside enemy group. Dance of Arrows (Q) 3-hit bounce off terrain. R (Lamb's Respite) ground makes ALL units unkillable briefly — use to save your team from a losing fight OR deny enemy from finishing.
Kindred.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR — marks increase damage output; use LDR vs heavy tanks
Kindred.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Kindred.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs dive

Kled.build_note: Dismount mechanic: at 0 HP Kled falls off Skaarl — remount by dealing damage. Violent Tendencies (W passive) every 8s: 4 empowered autos that deal % max HP. Jousting (E) two-part dash: forward then recast to return. Chaaaaarge!!! (R) charge ALL teammates toward target — massive teamwide engage. In ARAM: R initiates the whole team. Use E forward then remount with W procs if dismounted.
Kled.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — Skaarl dismount and remount mechanic
Kled.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both

Kog'Maw.build_note: AP/on-hit hybrid. W (Bio-Arcane Barrage) deals % max HP magic damage — active as much as possible. Nashor's Tooth + W = sustained tank shred. No dashes, no escapes — play at max W range (680). Stack AP to maximize % HP damage. R (Living Artillery) for long-range execute from safety.
Kog'Maw.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + Void Staff — W % max HP damage through MR
Kog'Maw.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder stays in core build
Kog'Maw.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Mortal Reminder if heavy poke/burst

LeBlanc.build_note: Distortion (W) two-part: land, recast to return. Combo: Q-mark → W-dash → auto → E-chain → W-return. Mimic (R) copies last ability: R-W = double Distortion for maximum gap-close burst. Ethereal Chains (E) root on second hit — use to lock down target before full combo. Shatter Orb (Q) mark: next ability on Q'd target deals bonus damage.
LeBlanc.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; burst one target at a time
LeBlanc.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs ranged poke burst

Lee Sin.build_note: Sonic Wave (Q1) → Resonating Strike (Q2) dash to target. Safeguard (W1) dash to ally → Iron Will (W2) sustain. Tempest (E1) AOE blind → Cripple (E2) slow. Dragon's Rage (R) kick target: kicks target AND any enemies behind them. ARAM kick combo: kick the carry into your entire team. Ward hop: W to ward placed in safe position for escape. Flurry (passive) next 2 autos after ability are enhanced — weave autos between abilities.
Lee Sin.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical burst all abilities
Lee Sin.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Lee Sin.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Leona.build_note: Zenith Blade (E) dash + root on far enemy — use to initiate. Eclipse (W) gives auto attack empowerment and brief invulnerability — activate before taking damage. Solar Flare (R) AOE stun from distance — use to peel when enemy dives your backline. Sunlight passive: every stun/root applies Sunlight for 2s, ally autos pop it for bonus magic damage.
Leona.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Sunlight passive applies to all enemies hit by ally abilities
Leona.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst comps

Lillia.build_note: Lilting Lullaby (R) puts ALL enemies with Dream on them to sleep — apply Dream with any ability, then R sleeps them all. Blooming Blows (Q) aura damage + MS stack on hit. Watch Out! Eep! (W) slam AOE damage. Swirlseed (E) bouncing ball with sleep on landing. ARAM: keep Dream stacked on multiple enemies by AOE abilities, then R for mass sleep. Zhonya's during the sleep to survive counter-engage.
Lillia.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Lilting Lullaby puts enemies to sleep for easy follows
Lillia.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Lissandra.build_note: Glacial Path (E) claw — re-cast to teleport to claw location: use to escape OR flank. Ice Shard (Q) passes through and splits. Ring of Frost (W) AOE root. Frozen Tomb (R) freeze self for 2.5s invulnerable (free Zhonya's on demand) OR freeze an enemy for same duration. ARAM: R yourself when dove by multiple enemies — invulnerable + Zhonya's is essentially 5s immunity.
Lissandra.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic, Rylai slow keeps enemies in ice zone
Lissandra.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Shadowflame vs burst mages

Lucian.build_note: Trinity Force FIRST, every time. Q activates Spellblade AND Lightslinger simultaneously: Q-proc + Spellblade-empowered auto + second auto = 3-hit burst per ability use. Phantom Dancer ghost supplements E for gap closing. His range is short — dash in, burst, dash out. Never RFC (siege item, wrong for his kit). Never pure crit without TF.
Lucian.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — TF + Navori haste means more Q cycles which amplifies LDR value
Lucian.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Lucian.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer if 3+ assassins/divers — keep TF core always
Lucian.kit_notes: Q procs Spellblade + Lightslinger: empowered auto + second auto in one cycle. E gaps close and procs Lightslinger again. Weave: Q→auto→auto→E→auto→auto. Phantom Dancer ghost + E = two repositioning tools per fight. Never auto without a Lightslinger proc queued.
Lucian.aram_specific: Short range forces aggressive positioning — ISB shield is important vs dive-heavy ARAM. Phantom Dancer ghost can escape engage or chase. TF haste reduces Q CD so you proc Lightslinger more frequently.

Lulu.build_note: Whimsy (W): on ally = speed boost + Attack speed, on enemy = polymorph. Ult (R) on your carry entering a fight — NOT when they're already low HP. Shield (E) on the ally about to take damage. Pix follows allies when you W them — use this to attach Pix to the engage champion for bonus autoattack damage. Polymorph the enemy carry with W before they burst yours.
Lulu.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Ardent Censer vs heavy burst

Lux.build_note: Q root confirms every E+R combo. Lucent Singularity (E) proc at max range forces choice: take the damage or dodge and lose position. Final Spark (R) after Q root = guaranteed kill on squishy. CDR from Luden's lets you rotate Q-E-Q faster. Passive illumination applies free bonus magic damage on autos after abilities.
Lux.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Magic pen for tanks buying MR vs Lux damage
Lux.vs_healing: Morellonomicon — can apply via auto attacks
Lux.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Void Staff if heavy poke burst

Malphite.build_note: Build armor = more R damage AND tankier. R (Unstoppable Force) damage scales with armor. Go: engage R → Q slow → autos with Thornmail grievous. In ARAM: perfect R setup = wait for enemies to group at health pack, then launch from behind. Never engage 1v5 — wait for ally initiation then R follow-up.
Malphite.vs_tanks: Thornmail applies Grievous on your autos — stack armor for maximum R launch power
Malphite.vs_healing: Thornmail in core — provides Grievous Wounds on auto
Malphite.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle Stoneplate vs pure burst

Malzahar.build_note: Void Swarm (W) spawns voidlings that attack Malefic Visions targets — E applies vision, W spawns swarm, swarm auto-attacks anything with vision. R (Nether Grasp) channels suppression on one target — use when ally can follow up. Passive gives spell shield every 14s — time it to block incoming CC before channeling R.
Malzahar.vs_tanks: Void Staff + Liandry's Anguish instead of Shadowflame — sustained % HP burn
Malzahar.vs_healing: Morellonomicon via auto between Q and E
Malzahar.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Morellonomicon (he already has passive void shield)

Maokai.build_note: Sap Magic (passive) heals every 5 nearby ability hits — every ARAM ability hits Maokai = constant healing. Sapling Toss (E) saplings do % max HP magic damage when triggered by enemies — throw saplings into brush and health pack areas. Twisted Advance (W) tree grab root. Bramble Smash (Q) AOE knock-back. Nature's Grasp (R) root wave down the corridor — throw R down ARAM lane for full-corridor root.
Maokai.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Bramble Smash (Q) applies grievous on hit
Maokai.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Force of Nature vs burst

Master Yi.build_note: Alpha Strike (Q) makes Yi untargetable briefly — use during enemy burst (Malphite R, Lux R) to dodge it entirely. Meditate (W) channels massive healing — use at 20% HP behind cover to regen to fighting health. Highlander (R) reset on kill/assist: chain R kills through grouped teams. Never engage without a near-kill opportunity — need the reset to survive. Guinsoo's Rageblade as 3rd item if carrying consistently.
Master Yi.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + LDR — Yi's resets make him need one anti-heal slot
Master Yi.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR if 2+ sustain enemies — never both
Master Yi.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Ravenous Hydra vs heavy burst

Miss Fortune.build_note: Collector first for early lethality + execute. LDR is the default armor pen (mandatory vs Malphite/Amumu/Rammus). IE requires 60% crit — with Collector (25%) + LDR (0%) = only 25% before IE. Fix: add Phantom Dancer or RFC as 3rd item for crit before IE. Bullet Time into grouped ARAM = free penta potential every fight.
Miss Fortune.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards mandatory — Collector (25%) + Phantom Dancer (20%) = 45% before IE; LDR has 0% crit
Miss Fortune.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Miss Fortune.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer if 3+ divers — delays IE but shields during ult
Miss Fortune.kit_notes: Double Up (Q) bounces off enemies hit by E-marked targets for double damage. Love Tap passive: alternate between targets for bonus damage. Strut (W) — fully charge before every fight by staying out of combat 5s. Bullet Time channels through frontline — position at 30-45 degree angle to hit 3+ enemies.
Miss Fortune.aram_specific: Pre-channel position: find 30-45 degree angle so Bullet Time hits 3+ grouped enemies. Never ult into a single target. Strut is free movement speed if you don't get hit in lane brush — stay behind minions to farm Strut stacks freely.

Mordekaiser.build_note: R (Realm of Death) removes one enemy from the fight and steals their stats. Target: the enemy carry or the most dangerous threat. In Realm: full damage fight 1v1 — use E knockback → Q+auto rotation. Exit realm after winning. Riftmaker heals % of damage dealt in extended fights. Never R a tank — R the fed assassin or carry.
Mordekaiser.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all sources magic, Realm of Death (R) negates tank items
Mordekaiser.vs_healing: No anti-heal — sustained AP fight in death realm
Mordekaiser.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs burst poke

Morgana.build_note: Dark Binding (Q) root for 3s — aim at feet of moving targets. Tormented Soil (W) AOE burn: melts tanks and grouped enemies over 5s. Black Shield (E) absorbs crowd control AND magic damage on one ally — save for hard CC like Amumu R or Nautilus hook. Soul Shackles (R) chain to all nearby enemies — Zhonya's yourself mid-R to extend and prevent interrupt.
Morgana.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; W pool burns through MR
Morgana.vs_healing: No anti-heal — Tormented Soil sustain damage
Morgana.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs burst

Naafiri.build_note: Packmates (passive) spawn on kills, revive when Naafiri takes damage. Q (Darkin Daggers) two daggers that apply bleed on overlap. W (Hounds' Pursuit) leaps with all packmates — massive burst on landing. E (Eviscerate) dash + reposition. R (We Are More) gives huge AD and packmate army — engage R first then W-dash onto carry.
Naafiri.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — packmates attack alongside for physical DPS
Naafiri.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Naafiri.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Serpent's Fang vs burst

Nami.build_note: Aqua Prison (Q) bubble — aim at feet of moving enemies, not where they are. Ebb and Flow (W) healing/damage bounces 3 times — start on ally to heal, then bounce to enemy. Tidecaller's Blessing (E) buffs ally autos with slow — put on your ADC. R (Tidal Wave) knocks up entire corridor in a line — throw at grouped enemies approaching. Buff carry with E before fights.
Nami.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Mikael's vs burst

Nasus.build_note: Stack Siphoning Strike (Q) on EVERY minion — each cannon kill = +12 stacks, champion kill = +6. By 100 stacks Q does massive damage. R (Fury of the Sands) gives HP, 3x Q bonus damage, and AOE aura damage for 15s — use at grouped fights. Spirit Fire (E) reduces enemy armor — E a group before Q empowered auto. ARAM gives free farm opportunity — Q every cannon without mercy.
Nasus.vs_tanks: Thornmail — autos apply grievous; Siphoning Strike shreds tanks when stacked
Nasus.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Nautilus.build_note: Dredge Line (Q) hooks far target — hit one, dash to them. Titan's Wrath (W) shield + empowered autos rooting targets. R (Depth Charge) launches seismic wave that bounces to up to 5 targets — throw at a group for chain knockup. ARAM: R is most valuable if enemy groups — wait for clump then R → Q hook to lock one out of position.
Nautilus.vs_tanks: Thornmail — passive auto root applies during shield activation
Nautilus.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Neeko.build_note: Tangle-Barbs (E) — throw through minions to root entire enemy group. W clone confuses enemy targeting. R (Pop Blossom) leaps into air, becomes untargetable briefly, then AOE stun + damage — use mid-fight when enemies are grouped. Q (Blooming Burst) hits twice vs champions. Disguise as ally to bait enemies into engaging.
Neeko.vs_tanks: Void Staff — Q root into full combo
Neeko.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs poke comps

Nidalee.build_note: Javelin Toss (Q human) at maximum range deals 200%+ damage — always throw from max range. Pounce (cougar Q) resets when hitting a hunted target. Hunt passive: Javelin and trap hits mark targets as hunted. Combo: Q long range spear → transform cougar → Pounce (reset) → Takedown Q → Swipe E. Primal Surge (W human) heals ally or self — maintain health for aggressive cougar dives.
Nidalee.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Nilah.build_note: Rush Kraken Slayer -> BotRK -> Immortal Shieldbow. MELEE in ARAM—play for skirmish windows not poke wars. Engage with ally CC, never alone. Skip RFC (melee range, can't reach bonus).

Nocturne.build_note: Duskbringer (Q) trail gives AS and moves through enemies. Shroud of Darkness (W) passive AS boost; active spell shield once. Unspeakable Horror (E) fears after 2s of attachment. Paranoia (R) reduces enemy vision to near-zero AND dashes to one target. ARAM: R cuts off enemy vision — perfect timing when enemy engages or groups at health packs.
Nocturne.vs_tanks: LDR — Collector(25%)+Navori(25%)=50% crit, LDR for armor pen on frontline
Nocturne.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDiar vs healing — never both

Nunu & Willump.build_note: Call of the Freljord (passive) nearby allies gain AS and MS. Consume (Q) huge self-heal based on target HP — eat a minion at 30% HP to restore massive amounts. Biggest Snowball Ever! (W) rolling ball that grows and knocks up — aim diagonally across ARAM corridor for max distance and knock-up. Snowball Barrage (E) AOE root. Absolute Zero (R) channeled massive AOE that increases in damage — protect Nunu during R or Zhonya's for 2.5s extend.
Nunu & Willump.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Snowball Barrage (E) AOE + Absolute Zero (R) does % max HP
Nunu & Willump.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Olaf.build_note: Berserker Rage (passive) — increases AS as HP decreases: fight at LOW HP. R (Ragnarok) makes Olaf CC-immune — walk through any CC to reach the backline. E (Reckless Swing) deals fixed HP damage to both Olaf and target — use at 20% HP when passive is maxed for insane DPS. Use R aggressively — engage, kill one, reset fights.
Olaf.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Ragnarok (R) makes him untargetable by CC, walks through tanks
Olaf.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Orianna.build_note: Ball placement: always attach to the most aggressive ally frontliner. Q (Command: Attack) moves ball, W (Command: Dissonance) AOE speed + slow at ball location. R (Command: Shockwave) pulls ALL enemies at ball location — place ball inside enemy group, use R for game-winning wombo. Lich Bane: basic attack after Q for bonus damage.
Orianna.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Lich Bane vs heavy poke

Ornn.build_note: Living Forge (passive) upgrades his own and ally items to Masterwork versions — massive teamwide stat buff. Upgrade ally items at level 13/14 via W. Vex.vs_tanks: Void Staff — fear passive reduces incoming poke safety
Vex.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke damage

Vi.build_note: Denting Blows (W passive) every 3 autos reduces target armor by 20% for 4s — focus one target with 3 autos before Q or R. Vault Breaker (Q) charge dash: hold to extend range. Excessive Force (E) launches blast through target. Cease and Desist (R) targeted dash that locks onto enemy — cannot be stopped. In ARAM: R the carry → W 3-auto armor shred → Q reset → burst combo.
Vi.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical damage armor pen stack
Vi.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both

Viktor.build_note: Evolve Q first for shield during teamfights. E (Death Ray) upgraded = creates explosion trail: fire E → laser → explosion AOE combo. W (Gravity Field) slow + stun in corridor — place to control health pack approaches. R (Chaos Storm) moveable: drag through grouped enemies continuously. Augment stacks from takeoffs — use Q shield in every fight.
Viktor.vs_tanks: Void Staff — laser melts tanks with magic pen
Viktor.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs ability poke

Volibear.build_note: The Relentless Storm (passive): AS increases as fight continues — stay in prolonged fights. Frenzied Maul (W) bite: heals Volibear based on damage dealt AND applies grievous. Sky Splitter (E) lightning bolt delayed AOE. Stormbringer (R) leap slam: disables nearby towers for 5s AND is huge AOE — leap into ARAM chokepoint for max value. W provides self-grievous cure — heal through incoming grievous.
Volibear.vs_tanks: Thornmail — autos reduce enemy heal; Thundering Smash (Q) stun
Volibear.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Warwick.build_note: Blood Hunt (E) — track enemies below 50% HP through walls. R (Infinite Duress) suppresses one target for 1.5s — use on the carry, never the tank. Q (Jaws of the Beast) locks onto target through walls — use on fleeing enemies. Primal Howl (W) reduces damage by 40% for 2.5s — activate before taking burst. Build tanky: he already heals from Q, TF gives HP.
Warwick.vs_tanks: Thornmail — Infinite Duress suppresses while allies kill the carry

Wukong.build_note: Warrior Trickster (W) clone: drops decoy then stealth for 1s — bait abilities with decoy. Crushing Blow (Q) reduces enemy armor for 3s. Cyclone (R) two-charge spin — can interrupt with movement. ARAM: R through the entire corridor for grouped knock-up. TF Spellblade procs on Q for bonus burst. Clone placement: drop clone in enemy team, stealth behind, then R from surprise angle.
Wukong.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — physical damage with AOE spin
Wukong.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Wukong.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Xayah.build_note: Season 16: Yun Tal Wildarrows gives 0% crit (pure AS). Build RFC second for 25% crit, then Collector for 50% crit before IE (75% total, IE fully active). R (Featherstorm) invincibility on demand is ARAM's best defensive ADC ability — use it to dodge every ult and engage.
Xayah.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th — Feathers bounce through tanks for good damage
Xayah.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
Xayah.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 4th replaces The Collector — still hits 50% crit for IE
Xayah.kit_notes: Auto-E-auto pattern: autos plant feathers, E pulls them back rooting caught enemies. Double Daggers (Q) fires two feathers — use before E for maximum feather recall. R Featherstorm: INVINCIBLE during — use it to dodge any CC or burst. Rakan passive (Lovers' Leap) only if Rakan is your support.
Xayah.aram_specific: Time R to dodge the enemy's biggest ability (Malphite R, Amumu R, Lux R). Never pre-cast R — wait to see the threat. Plant feathers with autos first, then use E to pull them back through grouped enemies for AOE root. Crowd the middle of ARAM for maximum feather coverage.

Xerath.build_note: Horizon Focus: hits from beyond 750 range deal 10% bonus damage — Xerath is ALWAYS beyond 750 range. R (Rite of the Arcane) hits from anywhere on map — throw during any grouped fight for free damage. Never be within auto range of anyone. Q charges deal damage at max range every 6 stacks.
Xerath.vs_tanks: Void Staff mandatory — all damage is magic
Xerath.vs_healing: No anti-heal (magic user) — rely on burst kill
Xerath.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Horizon Focus vs heavy poke

Xin Zhao.build_note: Three Talon Strike (Q) reduces CD per hit — spam for knock-ups. Audacious Charge (E) dash to target, slows nearby. Crescent Guard (R) creates a zone that ONLY Xin Zhao and allies can be in — carries are displaced outside, tanks/frontline stay. In ARAM: R to split the carry from their team, burst them alone. Battle Cry (W) heals and gains AS — sustain in extended fights.
Xin Zhao.vs_tanks: LDR — physical, Three Talon Strike (Q) knock-up on third hit
Xin Zhao.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Xin Zhao.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Mortal Reminder vs burst

Yasuo.build_note: Yasuo has double crit chance from passive — IE activates fully with ISB+Collector (50% stated = 100% effective crit). Steel Tempest (Q) three charges: Q3 is the tornado knock-up — save it for R combo. Sweeping Blade (E) dash through enemy — Q immediately after E for bonus damage. Last Breath (R) requires airborne target — use Q3 tornado or ally knock-up. Wind Wall (W) blocks ALL projectiles for 4s — block Jinx rocket, Lux beam, any projectile ult.
Yasuo.vs_tanks: LDR — ISB(25%)+Collector(25%)+IE(25%)=75% crit; double crit passive
Yasuo.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both

Yone.build_note: Way of the Hunter (passive): every other auto deals magic damage — build AD and it auto-converts 50% to magic. Mortal Steel (Q) double cast: two Q's in rapid succession dash forward. Spirit Cleave (W) cleaving AOE + shield from damage dealt. Soul Unbound (E) separates soul: soul flies forward freely for 5s, then snaps back dealing 8% damage taken. Fate Sealed (R) sweeping dash through enemies. E into enemy group → R sweep → return for damage.
Yone.vs_tanks: LDR — physical + magic split; armor pen applies to physical portion
Yone.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Yone.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Yorick.build_note: Last Rites (Q) empowered auto spawns ghoul on kill. Mourning Mist (W) marks area: Yorick and ghouls deal more damage to marked target. Mourning's End (R) summons Maiden of the Mist: Maiden is a powerful companion that fights independently and spawns Walkers. In ARAM: point Maiden at carry — she and ghouls will shred through anyone. Dark Procession (E) wall of ghouls that blocks movement — wall off enemy retreat path.
Yorick.vs_tanks: Thornmail — ghouls attack the entire enemy team; Maiden applies grievous

Yuumi.build_note: Stay ATTACHED to your most mobile/aggressive ally. W attach gives Yuumi untargetability (except tower damage). Q (Prowling Projectile) fires slow missile that deals more damage if hitting non-Yuumi-attached enemy — use while attached. R (Final Chapter) channels 7 healing waves and roots enemies — activate during enemy engage for max healing + CC. Never detach mid-fight unless forced.
Yuumi.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Zhonya's — but Zhonya's while attached does nothing

Zac.build_note: Cell Division (passive) chunks: collect your own chunks to heal — pick up chunks during/after fights. Stretching Strikes (Q) grabs and slams two targets together. Unstable Matter (W) AOE % max HP damage — use vs tanks. Elastic Slingshot (E) long range launch at target — can launch from behind terrain. Let's Bounce (R) bounce through enemies 4 times knock-upping the whole group each bounce. In ARAM: E into enemy group → R bounce through everyone.
Zac.vs_tanks: Thornmail — more HP = more Let's Bounce (R) damage and more chunks
Zac.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Zed.build_note: W-R-W-E-Q-auto combo: cast W shadow → R on carry → W back to shadow for R extension → E shurikens → Q through target. Death Mark (R) marks target, detonates after 3s for bonus damage based on damage dealt. Duskblade invisibility after R in teamfights. ARAM note: short range — needs teammates to create the gap-close opportunity.
Zed.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's — full armor pen stack, physical damage only
Zed.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR if 2+ sustain enemies — never both
Zed.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Mortal Reminder vs burst

Zeri.build_note: Q (Burst Fire) long-hold = charged shot through terrain. E (Spark Surge) wall-hop dash for repositioning. R (Lightning Crash) overcharges: every kill extends duration. Guinsoo's converts crits to double on-hit for Kraken synergy. W (Ultrashock Laser) slows and reveals — use before R engagement.
Zeri.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR + Guinsoo double on-hit — Q electric charges through walls
Zeri.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing — never both
Zeri.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Guinsoo's vs heavy burst

Ziggs.build_note: Hexplosive Minefield (E) at health pack paths — slows and damages. Satchel Charge (W) under yourself = jump over terrain. R (Mega Inferno Bomb) global — always on cooldown. Short Fuse (passive) every 12s: deny enemy health pack collection with empowered auto.
Ziggs.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Short Fuse empowered auto denies health packs
Ziggs.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs burst

Zilean.build_note: Time Bomb (Q) two bombs on same target = AOE stun. Rewind (W) reduces your Q and E cooldowns — alternate Q → W → Q for double bombs. Time Warp (E) speeds ally or slows enemy. Chronoshift (R) puts target in stasis then revives them with HP at expiry — ult your carry when they start taking focus. Q→W→Q double bomb is the primary damage tool. R placement timing: cast on carry at 20% HP before they die.
Zilean.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; bombs deal % max HP when double-stacked
Zilean.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Locket vs poke mages

Zoe.build_note: Sleepy Trouble Bubble (E) tosses to location — sleeping target takes DOUBLE damage from next hit. Full combo: E-sleep → Portal Jump (R) → Q amplified with sleep debuff. Paddle Star (Q) second cast redirects. Spell Thief (W) picks up summoner spells and item actives dropped by enemies — can pick up Flash for extra blink. Bubble through terrain. R Portal Jump: blink briefly and return — use as poke tool.
Zoe.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; sleep combo amplifies all damage
Zoe.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs burst

Zyra.build_note: Plants spawn near seeds when abilities pass through them. Q (Deadly Spines) + W seed = vine lashers (slow). E (Grasping Roots) root + W seed = thornspitters (ranged). Layer seeds before fights then root into full plant garden. R (Stranglethorns) knock-up: use when enemy groups — all plants in range get enraged. Plant thorns at health pack approaches for zone control.
Zyra.vs_tanks: Void Staff — all magic; Rylai slow keeps enemies in plant range
Zyra.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Shadowflame vs burst
